result.summary: 本文提出了 Transformer，一种完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环与卷积的序列转导模型架构 [S1.p4]。作者在 WMT 2014 英德与英法翻译任务上验证该模型，英德任务上 big 模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（含集成模型）2 BLEU 以上 [S6.SS1.p1]；英法任务上 big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于此前所有已发表的单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。作者还将 Transformer 应用于英语成分句法分析，表明其能泛化到其他任务 [S6.SS3.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output

method.text: Transformer 采用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络两个子层，并围绕每个子层使用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后经 softmax 得到权重，再对 value 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。模型使用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。由于模型不含循环与卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1]。

evidence.quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
The first is a multi-head self-attention mechanism, and the second is a simple, position-wise fully connected feed-forward network.
We employ a residual connection around each of the two sub-layers, followed by layer normalization.
We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.
we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence
we add "positional encodings" to the input embeddings at the bottoms of the encoder and decoder stacks

experiments.text: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享约 37000 词的 BPE 词表）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 词 piece 词表）[S5.SS1.p1]。模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。作者还在英语成分句法分析任务上验证泛化性，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句的语料 [S6.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
For English-French, we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences
We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
We trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours.
The big models were trained for 300,000 steps (3.5 days).
We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
using the larger high-confidence and BerkleyParser corpora from with approximately 17M sentences

findings.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（含集成模型）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 的新最优 BLEU [S6.SS1.p1]。在 WMT 2014 英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于此前所有已发表的单模型，训练成本不到此前最优模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。消融实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码，结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。在英语成分句法分析上，模型在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也优于 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model
While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results to the base model
the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences

limitations.text: 作者指出，自注意力将任意两位置间的操作数降为常数，但代价是注意力加权位置平均导致有效分辨率降低，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心的、大小为 r 的邻域内，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。作者还计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频、视频等大规模输入输出 [S7.p3]。

evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text
to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video
